annotations.title: Room under the ACA subsidy line

description: Answers "how much can I convert without losing the ACA subsidy" and "how close am I to the ACA subsidy cliff": the 400%-of-poverty line for a household size and coverage year, the room under it, the expected contribution, and with a benchmark silver premium the premium tax credit and what filling the room costs. Also "do I get cost-sharing reductions" and "how low does my income need to be for a better silver plan": the CSR tier (94%, 87% or 73% silver up to 250% of poverty) with its out-of-pocket maximum and room to the tier line; with a state, whether Medicaid or a Basic Health Program covers that income instead, and the Alaska or Hawaii guideline. Read-only.

benchmarkMonthly.description: Second-lowest-cost silver plan premium a month for the household, if known; adds the credit in dollars.

coverageYear.description: Marketplace coverage year (2026 or 2027). Defaults to 2026.

magi.description: Household MAGI for the premium tax credit (AGI plus tax-exempt interest and non-taxable Social Security) before any Roth conversion, US dollars a year.

state.description: Two-letter state code, if known. Sets Medicaid (expansion states up to 138% FPL), Basic Health Programs (MN, NY, OR, DC up to 200% FPL) and the Alaska and Hawaii poverty guidelines.

name: aca_subsidy_line

contributionAtLine.description: Expected contribution a year with MAGI exactly at the line.

costSharingLines.description: The 150%, 200% and 250% FPL lines in MAGI for this household.

tierTopLine.description: MAGI at the top of this tier (150%, 200% or 250% FPL).

costSharingReduction.description: Cost-sharing reduction on a silver plan; null when none applies.

credit.description: A year; null without a benchmark premium.

creditLostAtLine.description: Credit given up by filling the whole room: the drop in credit, or without a benchmark the rise in expected contribution.

disclaimer.const: Not tax, legal or investment advice.

medicaidLine.description: MAGI at 138% FPL, the Medicaid expansion line; null in a non-expansion state.

plannerLink.description: Opens the Dipperfield planner with these inputs filled in; the inputs travel in the link fragment, which browsers never send to a server.

program.description: Where this income lands: the marketplace credit, Medicaid, the state Basic Health Program, the coverage gap (non-expansion state below 100% FPL), below 100% with no state given, or over the 400% line.

roomUnderLine.description: Most a Roth conversion or other income can add and keep MAGI at the line; negative when already over.

title: Room under the ACA subsidy line
